description: This file defines the Shipping class in the Opencart catalog extension for Total calculations, providing functionality to compute and add shipping costs to the order totals within the OpenCart e-commerce platform.

classes.name: Shipping
classes.description: Represents the shipping total extension in the OpenCart system, responsible for calculating and adding shipping costs to the total order amount.

methods.name: getTotal
methods.description: Calculates and adds the shipping cost to the total, and updates taxes accordingly based on shipping method and session data.
